resources.string: Describe the topic you want to generate questions about.
Click to add a reference photo

Act as a university professor who is an expert in the specified area. Objective: Generate %1$d questions on the topic "%2$s". %5$s General conditions: - Difficulty: %3$d out of 2 - Estimated time per question: %4$d seconds - Do not include explanations or solutions - Do not copy content verbatim - Vary the focus of the questions
Format and notation: - If the topic is mathematical or formal, use Markdown - The content may include rich text - The result must be valid JSON
Output format: Returns only JSON with the following structure: [ { "id": number, "question": "string (may contain Markdown)", "answers": [ { "id": number "text": "string (may contain Markdown)", "correct": boolean } ] } ]
IMPORTANT OUTPUT RULES: - Return ONLY raw JSON - Do NOT wrap the response in Markdown - Do NOT use ```json``` or ``` - Do NOT add explanations, comments, or extra text - The response must start with { or [ and end with } or ]
Entry: Reference information is provided in text only.

Input: - Text: Defines the topic, difficulty, and format - Image: Corresponds to an actual exam and is used only for reference
Use of the image: - Analyze style, format, and level - Do not copy or rephrase questions - Generate new questions based on the analysis.
